players.bio: Adam Obert is a Slovak football player defender for Cagliari.

Alen Sherri (born 15 December 1997) is an Albanian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Italian Serie A club Cagliari and the Albania national team. Sherri received his first call up to the Albania under-21 national team by the head coach Skënder Gega on 8 June 2015 for the Friendly matches against Kazakhstan & Sweden on 12 & 16 June 2015.
Alessandro Deiola (born 1 August 1995) is an Italian footballer who plays as a midfielder for Cagliari.

Alessandro Gianni Romano (born 17 June 2006) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Serie A club Cagliari, on loan from Roma. Born in Switzerland, Romano represented his country of birth at youth level before switching to the Italy national team.
Alieu Fadera (born 3 November 2001) is a Gambian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Serie A club Sassuolo on loan from Como.

Andrea Belotti (born 20 December 1993) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a striker for Serie A club Cagliari. Belotti started his career with AlbinoLeffe. He was later signed by Palermo, where he won a Serie B title in the 2013–14 season, before being joining Torino in 2015.
Boris Radunović (born 26 May 1996) is a Serbian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Serie A club Cagliari.

Daniel Maldini (born 11 October 2001) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or forward for Serie A club Lazio, on loan from Atalanta, and the Italy national team. Early life Maldini was born in Milan, the second son of Paolo Maldini, the captain of AC Milan, and Venezuelan model Adriana Fossa.
Elia Caprile (born 25 August 2001) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Serie A club Cagliari.
Giuseppe Ciocci (born 14 January 2002) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for the Serie A club Cagliari.
Harry Winks is an English professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Serie A club Cagliari.
Jacopo Fazzini (born 16 March 2003) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as midfielder for Serie A club Fiorentina.
Joseph Liteta (born 22 February 2006) is a Zambian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Italian Serie A club Cagliari and the Zambia national team.
Juan Martín Rodríguez Camejo (born 30 May 2005) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or left-back for Serie A club Cagliari.
Kevin Carlos Omoruyi Benjamin (born 10 April 2001), known as Kevin Carlos, is a Spanish footballer who plays as a forward for French Ligue 1 club Nice.
Kingstone Mutandwa is a 23-year-old Zambian professional footballer who plays as a centre-forward for the Italian Serie A club Cagliari Calcio and the Zambia national
Leonardo Pavoletti (born 26 November 1988) is an Italian footballer who plays as a striker for Serie A club Cagliari and the Italy national team.
M'Bala Nzola (born 18 August 1996) is an Angolan professional footballer who plays as a forward for Serie A club Pisa on loan from Fiorentina, and the Angola national team.
Marko Rog (born 19 July 1995) is a Croatian professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Serie A club Cagliari and the Croatia national team.
Mattia Felici (born 17 April 2001) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a left winger for Serie A club Cagliari.
Michel Ndary Adopo (born 19 July 2000) is a French professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Serie A club Cagliari.
Nicolò Cavuoti (born 4 April 2003) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Serie A club Cagliari.
Riyad Idrissi (born 13 June 2005) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a left-back for the Serie A club Cagliari.

Roberto Gagliardini (born 7 April 1994) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Serie A club Hellas Verona. On 28 February 2014, Gagliardini was called up to the Italy under-20 side. On 12 August 2015, he made his debut with the under-21 side under manager Luigi Di Biagio, in a friendly match against Hungary, which ended in a 0–0 draw.
Yanis Massolin (born 20 September 2002) is a French professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Modena on loan from Inter.
Yerry Fernando Mina González (born 23 September 1994) is a Colombian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Serie A club Cagliari and the Colombia national team.

Yukinari Sugawara is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a right-back or right wing-back for Serie A club Cagliari, on loan from EFL Championship club Southampton and the Japan national team.

José Pedro da Silva Figueiredo Freitas (born 6 June 1997), known as Zé Pedro, is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Serie A club Cagliari. Club career Early career Zé Pedro was born in Guimarães. He started playing football with local Vitória de Guimarães at the age of nine, and finished his youth career at Vizela.
